content: <thought>We need the SMILES of the unknown compound. The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 114.068 (100 %). The M+1 peak (≈6.7 %) suggests about 6 carbons (since each ¹³C adds ~1.1 %). Therefore the molecule likely contains ~6 C atoms. To identify the structure we should obtain additional spectroscopic data (¹H NMR, ¹³C NMR, IR) to narrow down possibilities before proposing a SMILES. The next cheapest experiment is a ¹H NMR spectrum.
